table: NASBO, Budget Processes in the States (2021), Table 13: Rainy Day Fund or Budget Stabilization Fund
rule: target: the share of a year's spending the state's rainy-day law fills its fund to (the required minimum where one is set, else the maximum size), summed where the law sets two general funds; deposit: the share of spending the law moves into the fund each year, where it sets one. A state whose law sets none is null and takes the median of the states that do.

AK.targetBasis: Constitutional Budget Reserve: no size set
AK.depositBasis: settlements and year-end sweeps, not a set share

AL.targetBasis: General Fund Rainy Day Fund: 10% of the previous year's General Fund appropriations (Amendment 803)
AL.depositBasis: repaid from the Alabama Trust Fund, not a set share

AR.targetBasis: Long Term Reserve Fund: no size set
AR.depositBasis: a transfer from the allotment reserve, not a set share

AZ.targetBasis: Budget Stabilization Fund: 10% of current-year General Fund revenue
AZ.depositBasis: revenue growth above the seven-year average, not a set share

CA.targetBasis: Budget Stabilization Account: 10% of General Fund tax revenues (Const. art. XVI, sec. 20)
CA.depositBasis: 1.5% of annual General Fund revenues, plus a share of capital gains

CO.targetBasis: General Fund reserve: 7.25% of General Fund appropriations
CO.depositBasis: set by the General Assembly each year

CT.targetBasis: Budget Reserve Fund: 15% of General Fund appropriations
CT.depositBasis: year-end surplus and volatile taxes, not a set share

DC.targetBasis: Fiscal Stabilization Reserve Fund: 2.34% of adjusted expenditures

DE.targetBasis: Budget Reserve Account: 5% of estimated General Fund revenue
DE.depositBasis: year-end surplus, not a set share

FL.targetBasis: Budget Stabilization Fund: at least 5% of the last year's General Revenue collections

GA.targetBasis: Revenue Shortfall Reserve: 15% of prior-year net treasury receipts
GA.depositBasis: year-end surplus lapses to it, not a set share

HI.targetBasis: Emergency and Budget Reserve Fund: no size set
HI.depositBasis: tobacco settlement and appropriations, not a set share

IA.targetBasis: Cash Reserve Fund 7.5% plus Economic Emergency Fund 2.5% of adjusted revenues
IA.depositBasis: the previous year's surplus, not a set share

ID.targetBasis: Budget Stabilization Fund: 10% of the previous year's General Fund receipts
ID.depositBasis: up to 1% of the previous year's collections when receipts grow more than 4%

IL.targetBasis: Budget Stabilization Fund: no size set

IN.targetBasis: Rainy Day Fund: set by personal income growth, no size in the table
IN.depositBasis: set by the growth of adjusted personal income

KS.targetBasis: Budget Stabilization Fund: no size set
KS.depositBasis: a share of revenue above the consensus estimate

KY.targetBasis: Budget Reserve Trust Fund: no size set
KY.depositBasis: surplus and appropriations, not a set share

LA.targetBasis: Budget Stabilization Fund: 4% of total state revenue receipts for the previous year
LA.depositBasis: mineral and nonrecurring revenue, not a set share

MA.targetBasis: Commonwealth Stabilization Fund: 15% of annual revenue
MA.depositBasis: year-end surplus and excess capital gains, not a set share

MD.targetBasis: Revenue Stabilization Account: 5% of estimated General Fund revenues
MD.depositBasis: mandated appropriations set by the fund's balance

ME.targetBasis: Budget Stabilization Fund: 12% of the previous year's General Fund revenues
ME.depositBasis: 48% of the unappropriated surplus, not a set share

MI.targetBasis: Countercyclical Budget and Economic Stabilization Fund: 15% of General Fund and School Aid Fund revenue

MN.targetBasis: Budget Reserve Account: a dollar amount set by revenue volatility ($2.4 billion in fiscal 2020-21), not a share
MN.depositBasis: one third of a November forecast balance

MO.targetBasis: Budget Reserve Fund: at least 7.5% of the previous year's net general revenue collections (Constitution)

MS.targetBasis: Working Cash Stabilization Reserve Fund: 10% of General Fund appropriation
MS.depositBasis: ending cash transfers, not a set share

MT.targetBasis: Budget Stabilization Reserve: 4.5% of appropriations in the second year of the biennium

NC.targetBasis: Savings Reserve: two years of need in 9 of 10 downturn scenarios, not a share

ND.targetBasis: Budget Stabilization Fund: 15% of appropriated General Fund expenditures
ND.depositBasis: filled to its maximum from the General Fund after the budget is set

NE.targetBasis: Cash Reserve Fund: no size set

NH.targetBasis: Revenue Stabilization Reserve Account: 10% of the last completed year's unrestricted General Fund revenue
NH.depositBasis: year-end surplus, not a set share

NJ.targetBasis: Surplus Revenue Fund: no size set

NM.targetBasis: Tax Stabilization Reserve: no size in the table

NV.targetBasis: Account to Stabilize the Operation of State Government: 20% of General Fund operating appropriations
NV.depositBasis: 40% of the ending balance above 7% of the General Fund

NY.targetBasis: Tax Stabilization Reserve 2% of the General Fund norm plus Rainy Day Reserve 5% of General Fund disbursements
NY.depositBasis: at most 0.2% of the General Fund norm a year to the Tax Stabilization Reserve

OH.targetBasis: Budget Stabilization Fund: 8.5% of the preceding year's General Revenue Fund revenues
OH.depositBasis: transfers from the General Revenue Fund

OK.targetBasis: Constitutional Reserve Fund: 15% of prior-year General Revenue collections

OR.targetBasis: Rainy Day Fund 7.5% plus Education Stability Fund 5% of the previous biennium's General Fund revenue
OR.depositBasis: 1% of the previous biennium's General Fund appropriations, half a percent a year

PA.targetBasis: Budget Stabilization Reserve Fund: the surplus transfer falls from 25% to 10% once the fund reaches 6% of General Fund revenues

RI.targetBasis: Budget Reserve and Cash Stabilization Fund: 5% of general revenue resources (Constitution)

SC.targetBasis: General Reserve 5% plus Capital Reserve 2% of the last completed year's General Fund revenues
SC.depositBasis: one-time transfers at the start of the year

SD.targetBasis: Budget Reserve Fund: 10% of the prior year's General Appropriations Act
SD.depositBasis: unspent general funds at year end

TN.targetBasis: Reserve for Revenue Fluctuations: 8% of General and Education Trust Fund allocations

TX.targetBasis: Economic Stabilization Fund: 10% of general revenue deposited over the preceding two-year biennium, 20% of one year's
TX.depositBasis: half of the unencumbered general revenue balance

UT.targetBasis: General Fund Budget Reserve Account: 8% of General Fund appropriations

VA.targetBasis: Revenue Stabilization Fund: 15% of average annual income, corporate and sales tax revenue over the prior three years (Const. art. X, sec. 8)
VA.depositBasis: half the growth above the six-year average

VT.targetBasis: Budget Stabilization Reserves: 5% of the prior year's appropriations

WA.targetBasis: Budget Stabilization Account: no size in the table
WA.depositBasis: 1% of general state revenues each year (RCW 43.79.490)

WI.targetBasis: Budget Stabilization Fund: no size set

WV.targetBasis: Revenue Shortfall Reserve Fund: 13% of General Revenue appropriations
WV.depositBasis: the first half of the year-end surplus

WY.targetBasis: Legislative Stabilization Reserve Account: no size set
